{{Infobox character | name = Hornfels | image = Hornfels.png | race = Hearthian | planet = Timber Hearth | location = Observatory }} '''Hornfels''' is a [[Hearthian]] who acts as Ground Control and the Museum Curator for [[Outer Wilds Ventures]]. They are one of the space program's founding members. == Dialogue == ===Initial Conversation=== * “There you are! I just finished pre-flight observations, and local conditions are good. Time to get our newest astronaut off the ground!
And you’ll be our ''first'' astronaut ever equipped with a Nomai [[Translation tool|translator tool]]! I confess, I’ve been giddy all day just thinking about it.
We’re better equipped than ever to unravel the mysteries of the [[Nomai]]. You and [[Hal]] should be very proud of your work!
Tell me, what’s your plan once you’re in space?” ** ''' >I’m going to learn more about the Nomai.''' *** “I might have guessed as much! No sense in making a translator tool if you’re not going to use it to translate anything.
We’ve barely scratched the surface of the Nomai writing in our solar system, so we still know very little about them. We’ve no idea if they originated here or traveled here, or why they disappeared.
That tool of yours should prove indispensible in solving the mystery of this ancient species!” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ** ''' >I’ll meet up with the other [[travelers]].''' *** “You’re going to check in with them, are you? Not a bad plan - no one knows the solar system better than our astronauts.
Let’s see... [[Chert]] is on the [[Hourglass Twins]], [[Riebeck]] is on [[Brittle Hollow]], and [[Gabbro]] is on [[Giant's Deep|Giant's Deep]], last I checked.
And... Well, there’s [[Feldspar]], obviously, but of course we don’t know where they are, or if they’re even alive.
Feldspar has been lost for a very long time, I’m afraid.
...On a more cheerful note, you’ll find [[Esker]] stationed on [[the Attlerock]]. They’re not a traveler so much as a lunar local, but I’m sure they’d appreciate a visit nevertheless.” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ** ''' >I want to go somewhere no one’s gone before.''' *** “I like it! You’ll have plenty of options to choose from.
No one’s ever landed on [[the Interloper]] before, you know. Perhaps you’ll be the first?
I must say... Should you choose to go to [[Dark Bramble]], be ''very'' careful. No one’s explored there before, either, for what you’ll find are excellent reasons.” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ** ''' >I think I’ll start with something small.''' *** “You’d prefer to ease into things? That’s a sensible plan! More sensible than most of our astronauts tend to be, and that’s a fact.
Do you think you’ll go to the Attlerock, then? Our moon would be a safe place to travel to and get your bearings in space, and I’m sure Esker would appreciate the visit.
Plus, we don’t know what the [[The_Attlerock#Eye_Signal_Locator|ancient Nomai ruins on the moon]] are, or why they were built. You could put your new translator tool through its paces!” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ** ''' >I don’t know.''' *** “Haha! Overwhelmed by the options, perhaps? I don’t blame you.
If you need help getting started, you could go visit Esker on the moon. They’re alone on the Attlerock most of the time, so I’m sure they’d appreciate it.
Plus, we don’t know what the ancient Nomai ruins on the moon are, or why they were built. You could put your new translator tool through its paces!” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ** ''' >I’m gonna wing it!''' *** “Planning to follow in the footsteps of Feldspar and the great Outer Wilds Ventures tradition, are you? I might have guessed.
Well, see if you can’t put that translator tool of yours to good use while you’re out there!” **** [[#Launch Codes|Launch Codes]] ====Launch Codes==== * “Well then, looks like all that’s left is to send you off! All in all, it’s a fine day for a launch!” ** ''' >I’m ready to get off this rock!''' *** “Excellent! You’ll be needing the launch codes, then.
Here they are. Best get off the ground before Slate makes any more modifications to your ship, eh?
Good luck out there! Let me know if I can help you with anything.” **** Hornfels gives the launch codes ** ''' >I’m ready to die in space.''' *** “I’m not one for superstition, but isn’t that kind of unlucky to say before a launch?
At any rate, here are the launch codes. Try not to worry too much - our ships are every bit as safe as Slate could be persuaded to make them.
Best of luck out there! Let me know if I can help you with anything.” **** Hornfels gives the launch codes ===Followup conversation=== * “Hello again!” **[[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] (If already gone to space) * “Back so soon?” **[[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ===Second Loop or later=== * “Hey, look at this - the statue opened its eyes! Bet you wish you’d seen that happen, huh? Sigh... Me, too.
I’m not even a little closer to understanding what’s going on with this statue.” **[[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ===Question Menu=== * “Was there something you needed?” ** ''' >I found Feldspar!''' *** “You found Feldspar?! And they’re in Dark Bramble?! Stars above, this is wonderful news! Thank you! Thank you for finding them! That Feldspar didn’t immediately join you on your ship and return here is incredibly Feldspar of them. We were never entirely sure what Feldspar was thinking back then, either.
Still, we ought to fish them out of that dreadful place with all haste! I’ll radio Gossan and have them prepare a ship. It really should be Gossan who brings Feldspar home.
Again, thank you. You can hardly imagine how profoundly happy I am to hear they’re alive and unharmed.” **** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ** '''>The Nomai staue opened its eyes!''' *** "What? You say the statue opened its eyes and looked at you?! ...How wonderful for you. No, truly, that's wonderful! It really is. ...Even if I ''have'' been pouring over it every night for weeks. It's stupendous you were able to get a reaction from the statue just by glancing at it a few times. Ergh, sorry, that's not a very scientific thing to say, is it? I ''am'' glad. I'm just also insufferably, ''profoundly'' jealous. You'll have to forgive me. That aside - I have research to do! I wonder why the statue opened its eyes. Surely this means they aren't mere decorative ornaments...?" **** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ** ''' >Where are the other travelers?''' *** “Well, let’s see... Chert is on the Hourglass Twins, Riebeck is on Brittle Hollow, and Gabbro is on Giant’s Deep.
And... there’s Feldspar, obviously, but of course we don’t know where they are, or if they’re even still alive.
Feldspar has been lost for a very long time, I’m afraid." **** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ** ''' >Tell me more about Feldspar.''' *** “Feldspar was one of the four founding members of Outer Wilds, along with our flight coach [[Gossan]], [[Slate|Slate the engineer]], and me.
As ground control and later the museum curator, I didn’t work with Feldspar as closely as Slate and Gossan did. I ''can'' tell you Feldspar was absolutely fearless, though. Nothing scared them.
Test-piloted everything Slate ever built! It’s a wonder Feldspar lived to see space, frankly, but they did. Flew all sorts of dangerous stunts and explored everything they could find.
And then one day, they just... didn’t come back. We don’t know what happened, or where Feldspar went, or even whether they’re still alive.
It’s been a long time since they left.” **** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] ** ''' >No thanks, I’m good.''' *** “Take care!" == Trivia == * Hornfels wrote the placard at the fenced-off pocket of ghost matter. They also seem to have written all the museum placards, and likely other informational notices around the village. The placard for the quantum shard at the museum indicates they're one of the "level-headed among us" who view the shard's apparent movements as an optical illusion instead of Gabbro's superposition theory. * At the campfire site near the radio tower, Hornfels left a note describing stargazing at that location while waiting for photos to print from the [[Deep Space Satellite]], reflecting that they could use more patience and get so engrossed in their work that they don't like sunrise or daylight because it takes them away from the stars. They recorded three relaxation tips from Gabbro, "our resident expert in leisurely whiling away the hours," for tips on dozing off. They felt Gabbro would think they'd "finally cracked" if they found out about the notes, but won't accept sass from someone who deliberately burns their marshmallows. * In the Radio Tower, Hornfels' log from two days after the Deep Space Satellite's launch reflects their excitement when the historic first color pictures of the solar system start printing, exclaiming that this was ''art'' and they could stare at them all day. After noticing an anomaly, they sent Gabbro to check on an apparent malfunction in the deep space satellite. Gabbro recalls that Hornfels probably said what they thought the problem was, but tells Gabbro so many things that Gabbro sometimes tunes them out or pretends there's signal interference. Gabbro's own log recording near the satellite indicates that Hornfels gets on their case for lazing around: "See, Hornfels? I do ''too'' work!" * On Brittle Hollow, a note near Feldspar's spare jetpack fuel implies that Hornfels didn't think Feldspar was taking full advantage of having a Little Scout: "I do ''too'' use it, Hornfels, ya burnt marshmallow". Their Giant's Deep journal entry noted they couldn't wait to tell Hornfels and Gossan about their adventure reaching the planet's core. Later on, they tell the Protagonist that Hornfels would have had their head for continually risking their fragile, breakable ship to extreme conditions if they'd learned Feldspar had been riding the Giant's Deep cyclones again. * Hornfels has spoken to [[Tephra]] about Feldspar's disappearance, saying they were the best pilot ever but "got lost" and no one knows what happened to them. Tephra recalls that talking about Feldspar always makes Hornfels really sad. The Protagonist may respond that Hornfels shouldn't be telling Tephra that stuff; Tephra says Hornfels says that too, and also cautions the Protagonist against making Hornfels sad by disappearing like Feldspar did. Tephra's dialog also reveals that Hornfels didn't let them hide in the museum during their hide-and-seek game that day, saying they were making a nuisance of themself. * Esker mentions occasionally being in touch with ground control -- "Hornfels and Gossan, mostly--" who sometimes radio up to chat. * Slate is the first one who tells the Protagonist to get the launch codes from Hornfels at the observatory, where they usually are; Slate is beginning to think they live there. They find astrophysics more Hornfels's domain than their own. [[Spinel]] would also bet their day's fishing haul that Hornfels is at the observatory; they feel that's always a safe bet, claiming to never have seen them anywhere else. * Hal explains that Hornfels finished prepping the Nomai statue for display just that day, and that despite trying everything to get its eyes to open, all Hornfels has figured out about it so far is that it's "''crazy'' old and super tough", that it is made out of the same stone as the partial statue Chert brought back from the Hourglass Twins, and, after analyzing the fragment Gabbro chipped off the statue while hauling it back home, that the stone has properties which let it store information. * Hornfels was the one who noticed the star charts were out of date and asked Chert to update them. Chert, doing so in their camp on Ember Twin, thinks Hornfels is in deep denial about the other travelers lacking interest in doing real science. * Unique dialog from Gabbro in the first loop recounts that they radioed Hornfels about their weird experience with another Nomai statue, but Hornfels assumed they'd dreamed it. The two then talked about dreams until Hornfels reminded Gabbro to refill their oxygen tank before talking themself to death. In the second loop, Gabbro says they radioed Hornfels about their first death and then about being in a time loop, but Hornfels assumed they were being metaphorical and/or had a nightmare. In subsequent loops, they mention Hornfels never remembers such conversations conversations from one loop to the next. * Hornfels is one of the few Hearthians with unique to each mission's first loop, as nearly their entire Observatory interaction is replaced in subsequent loops with their excitement about the statue's open eyes. * As with all Hearthians, they are named after minerals. [[wikipedia:Hornfels|Hornfels]] is the group name for a set of contact metamorphic rocks that have been baked and hardened by the heat of intrusive igneous masses and have been rendered massive, hard, splintery, and in some cases exceedingly tough and durable.
